definitions.explanation: Suffix naming the rule or arrangement under which something operates: {予約|よやく}{制|せい} means run on a reservation basis, {会員|かいいん}{制|せい} means members only. Attaches to a noun describing the organizing principle, and the compound often stands alone as a notice.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{予約|よやく}{制|せい}です。
examples.english: This restaurant is by reservation only.

examples.japanese: {会員|かいいん}{制|せい}のジムに{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I go to a members-only gym.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{完全|かんぜん}{週休二日|しゅうきゅうふつか}{制|せい}になる。
examples.english: From next month we'll be on a full two-day weekend system.

examples.japanese: {年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}{制|せい}から{成果|せいか}{主義|しゅぎ}へ{移行|いこう}する{企業|きぎょう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More and more companies are shifting from a seniority system to performance-based pay.

notes:
Very productive in notices and workplace vocabulary. The compound is usually used with だ/です or attributively with の: {予約|よやく}{制|せい}の{病院|びょういん}.

COMPOUNDS:
- {予約|よやく}{制|せい}: by reservation only
- {会員|かいいん}{制|せい}: membership-based
- {交代|こうたい}{制|せい}: shift system
- {定額|ていがく}{制|せい}: flat-rate; subscription
- {二部|にぶ}{制|せい}: two-shift or two-session system
- {自己|じこ}{申告|しんこく}{制|せい}: self-declaration system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜{製|せい}: made of; made by — identical in sound, completely different meaning ({日本|にほん}{製|せい} made in Japan); the kanji is the only clue in speech
- 〜{式|しき}: style; type; method — {自動|じどう}{式|しき} automatic-type; describes how a thing works, not the rules people operate under
- {制度|せいど}: system; institution — the free-standing noun for the same idea
